description: This file defines the LoggerSubscriber class in the OrangeHRM project, which subscribes to exception events in the Symfony HTTP Kernel to log error messages and traces when exceptions occur.

classes.name: LoggerSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class for logging exceptions caught by the Symfony HTTP Kernel, extending AbstractEventSubscriber and utilizing service container traits.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping Symfony kernel exception events to handler methods, setting 'onExceptionEvent' to handle exceptions.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Event handler that retrieves the exception object from the event, logs its message and trace using the Logger service.
